skill.name: ralph-tui-prd
skill.description: Generate structured Product Requirements Documents for ralph-tui task orchestration. The skill asks clarifying questions, captures quality gates, and formats PRDs for downstream conversion.
skill.summary: Create execution-ready PRDs with user stories, quality gates, and ralph-tui parsing markers.

content.value_statement: Teams need clear requirements before assigning work to AI coding agents. This skill turns feature ideas into structured PRDs with user stories and quality gates for ralph-tui workflows.
actual_capabilities: Asks iterative clarifying questions before drafting a PRD.
Requires project-specific quality gates for every PRD.
Creates user stories with acceptance criteria and functional requirements.
Defines non-goals, technical considerations, success metrics, and open questions.
Wraps the final document in PRD markers for ralph-tui parsing.
limitations: It creates planning documents and does not implement features.
It depends on user answers for scope, priorities, and quality commands.
It does not validate generated requirements against the live repository.
It is tailored to ralph-tui workflows and may need adaptation elsewhere.

use_cases.title: Plan Agent-Ready Features
use_cases.description: Convert a feature idea into small user stories that an AI coding agent can execute in focused sessions.

use_cases.title: Standardize Engineering Intake
use_cases.description: Capture quality gates, scope boundaries, and acceptance criteria before work enters a ralph-tui queue.

use_cases.title: Prepare Conversion Inputs
use_cases.description: Draft PRDs that can be transformed into beads issues or structured execution files for automation.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic PRD
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple feature plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PRD for adding [feature] to my ralph-tui project. Ask clarifying questions first.

prompt_templates.title: Plan With Quality Gates
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request when project checks are known.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a PRD for [feature]. Use [quality commands] as required gates for each user story.

prompt_templates.title: Scope a Complex Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a feature with boundaries and dependencies.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PRD for [feature]. Include non-goals, technical considerations, success metrics, and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Agent Execution
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for downstream issue or execution conversion.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a ralph-tui-ready PRD for [feature]. Make each story independently completable by an AI coding agent.

output_examples.input: Create a PRD for dark mode in the TUI.
output_examples.output: Produces clarifying questions, then a PRD with goals, quality gates, four user stories, requirements, non-goals, and open questions.

output_examples.input: Plan a settings screen with typecheck and lint gates.
output_examples.output: Returns a structured PRD that includes the specified gates and acceptance criteria for each settings workflow.

output_examples.input: Spec out notification preferences for AI agent execution.
output_examples.output: Creates small implementation stories with clear scope, measurable success criteria, and ralph-tui parsing markers.

best_practices: Provide the feature goal, target users, and known constraints before asking for the PRD.
Choose quality gates that match the actual project commands.
Review generated user stories for size before converting them into execution tasks.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to implement the feature after drafting the PRD.
Do not accept vague acceptance criteria that cannot be verified.
Do not reuse example quality commands when the project uses different tooling.

faq.question: Does this skill write code?
faq.answer: No. It creates a PRD and explicitly tells the assistant not to implement the feature.

faq.question: Why does it ask about quality gates?
faq.answer: Quality gates make each user story verifiable before it is assigned to an AI coding agent.

faq.question: Can it create beads issues directly?
faq.answer: It creates PRD content that can be converted by ralph-tui tools into beads issues or structured execution files.

faq.question: Can I use it outside ralph-tui?
faq.answer: Yes, but the output markers and structure are optimized for ralph-tui parsing.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the feature idea, target users, expected behavior, boundaries, and known project commands.

faq.question: Does it run the quality commands it lists?
faq.answer: No. It records those commands as requirements for later implementation and verification.
